The servers refused this message because.it: I server hanno rifiutato il messaggio a causa delle loro regole di accesso.

The servers refused this message because.zh-CN: 服务器因其访问规则拒绝了此消息。
The servers refused this message because.zh-TW: 伺服器因其存取規則拒絕了此訊息。

The servers refused this message because.ko: 서버의 접근 규칙으로 인해 메시지가 거부되었습니다.

The servers require authentication befor.en: The servers require authentication before accepting this message.
The servers require authentication befor.fr: Les serveurs exigent une authentification pour accepter ce message.

The servers require authentication befor.zh-CN: 服务器要求先进行身份验证才能接收此消息。
The servers require authentication befor.zh-TW: 伺服器要求先進行身分驗證才能接收此訊息。

Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.en: Too many messages were sent. Wait a moment before retrying.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.fr: Trop de messages ont été envoyés. Patientez un instant avant de réessayer.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.it: Sono stati inviati troppi messaggi. Attendi un momento prima di riprovare.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.de: Es wurden zu viele Nachrichten gesendet. Warte einen Moment und versuche es erneut.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.es: Se enviaron demasiados mensajes. Espera un momento antes de reintentarlo.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.pt-BR: Muitas mensagens foram enviadas. Aguarde um pouco antes de tentar novamente.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.ru: Отправлено слишком много сообщений. Подождите немного и повторите попытку.
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.zh-CN: 发送的消息过多。请稍等片刻后重试。
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.zh-TW: 傳送的訊息過多。請稍等片刻後重試。
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.ja: 送信数の上限に達しました。しばらく待ってから再試行してください。
Too many messages were sent. Wait a mome.ko: 너무 많은 메시지를 보냈습니다. 잠시 기다린 후 다시 시도하세요.

The servers require proof of work that t.pt-BR: Os servidores exigem uma prova de trabalho que este app não pode fornecer.
The servers require proof of work that t.ru: Серверы требуют доказательство работы, которое это приложение не может предоставить.

The servers rejected this message as inv.en: The servers rejected this message as invalid.
The servers rejected this message as inv.fr: Les serveurs ont rejeté ce message car ils le jugent invalide.

The servers rejected this message as inv.zh-TW: 伺服器認為此訊息無效，已拒絕接收。
The servers rejected this message as inv.ja: このメッセージは無効としてサーバーに拒否されました。
The servers rejected this message as inv.ko: 서버에서 유효하지 않은 메시지로 판단하여 거부했습니다.

Could not reach the servers. Check your.en: Could not reach the servers. Check your connection and retry.
Could not reach the servers. Check your.fr: Impossible de joindre les serveurs. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
Could not reach the servers. Check your.it: Impossibile raggiungere i server. Controlla la connessione e riprova.

Sending was not authorized. Review the a.en: Sending was not authorized. Review the app permissions in the launcher.
Sending was not authorized. Review the a.fr: L’envoi n’a pas été autorisé. Vérifiez les autorisations de l’application dans le lanceur.

Sending was not authorized. Review the a.ru: Отправка не разрешена. Проверьте разрешения приложения в лаунчере.

Unlock your account in the launcher, the.en: Unlock your account in the launcher, then retry sending.
Unlock your account in the launcher, the.fr: Déverrouillez votre compte dans le lanceur, puis réessayez l’envoi.

Unlock your account in the launcher, the.pt-BR: Desbloqueie sua conta no launcher e tente enviar novamente.

Unlock your account in the launcher, the.zh-TW: 請在啟動器中解鎖帳戶，然後重新傳送。
Unlock your account in the launcher, the.ja: ランチャーでアカウントのロックを解除してから、送信を再試行してください。
Unlock your account in the launcher, the.ko: 런처에서 계정 잠금을 해제한 후 다시 전송하세요.

This account is read-only. Use an accoun.en: This account is read-only. Use an account that can sign messages.
This account is read-only. Use an accoun.fr: Ce compte est en lecture seule. Utilisez un compte pouvant signer des messages.
This account is read-only. Use an accoun.it: Questo account è di sola lettura. Usa un account che possa firmare messaggi.
This account is read-only. Use an accoun.de: Dieses Konto hat nur Lesezugriff. Verwende ein Konto, das Nachrichten signieren kann.

This account is read-only. Use an accoun.pt-BR: Esta conta é somente leitura. Use uma conta que possa assinar mensagens.
This account is read-only. Use an accoun.ru: Этот аккаунт доступен только для чтения. Используйте аккаунт с возможностью подписи сообщений.
This account is read-only. Use an accoun.zh-CN: 此账户为只读账户。请使用能够签署消息的账户。

This account is read-only. Use an accoun.ko: 이 계정은 읽기 전용입니다. 메시지에 서명할 수 있는 계정을 사용하세요.

The attachment is unavailable. Attach th.en: The attachment is unavailable. Attach the file again in a new message.
